description: This Java source file defines the DefaultFirebaseService class, which implements FirebaseService to send Firebase Cloud Messaging notifications. It manages Firebase contexts with caching, initializes Firebase apps with credentials, and constructs messages with notification and platform-specific configurations.

classes.name: DefaultFirebaseService
classes.description: Service class for sending Firebase Cloud Messaging notifications, managing Firebase contexts, and initializing Firebase apps with credentials.

classes.name: DefaultFirebaseService.FirebaseContext
classes.description: Inner class managing Firebase app and messaging instances per context, handling initialization, credential checks, and cleanup.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a Firebase Cloud Messaging notification with specified parameters, managing Firebase context and constructing message payload.

methods.name: FirebaseContext.constructor
methods.description: Initializes Firebase context with given key and credentials, setting up Firebase app and messaging instances.

methods.name: FirebaseContext.init
methods.description: Initializes Firebase app and messaging instances using provided credentials.

methods.name: FirebaseContext.check
methods.description: Checks if current credentials match; reinitializes if different, or throws if Firebase app is not properly initialized.

methods.name: FirebaseContext.destroy
methods.description: Cleans up Firebase app and messaging instances.
